subject: Split invoice reconciliation & PO routing for multi-entity customer
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novacorp.com>

Cc: accounts@novacorp.com, julien.moreau@novacorp-eu.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO 88711 — multi-entity billing / VAT split

Hi Soojin,

We're prepping to issue PO 88711 to Redwood but have two legal entities involved: Novacorp US (billing address in Delaware) and Novacorp EU (France) — they need separate VAT treatment and separate remit accounts for AP.

We have a single PO number from procurement but need your invoices to be split so each legal entity receives and is paid separately (we still want the PO traceability back to 88711). Is Redwood able to:

- Emit two invoices tied to the same PO (one for Novacorp US, one for Novacorp EU) while keeping the PO number intact?
- Include VAT IDs on the invoice header for the EU entity and show tax line calculations?
- Provide remit instructions for two separate bank accounts so our AP can route payments correctly?

I've attached the PO (Novacorp-PO-88711.pdf) and a short summary of the entities.

Also, procurement asks whether there is an AP onboarding packet and a vendor registration flow for Novacorp to add Redwood to their supplier registry — we can handle portal invites but want to align fields (tax ID, legal name, remit account name).

Can you confirm next steps and timeline? We're hoping to close billing setup before EOD next week.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of Procurement — Novacorp

Attachment: Novacorp-PO-88711.pdf (PDF, 124KB)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novacorp.com>
Cc: accounts@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO 88711 — multi-entity billing / VAT split

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear summary and the PO. Happy to help.

Short answers up front: yes, we can do separate invoices per legal entity while keeping a traceable link to PO 88711. We typically use a PO-suffix convention (e.g., 88711-US / 88711-EU) on the invoice metadata so AP systems can match by PO number and entity. For VAT: we will include the EU legal entity VAT ID and show the tax calculation line on the EU invoice. Remit: we can output different bank remittance instructions per invoice.

Next steps I suggest:
- Redwood AP onboarding packet (I attached our standard packet) — please fill and return the vendor registration form so we can be added to your supplier registry.
- Confirm the exact legal names and VAT / tax IDs to print on each invoice (I copied Julien in case he can confirm EU details).
- We will generate a sample pair of invoices (no payment) that match your PO matching rules for you to validate.
- Decide on payment terms: are you requesting Net30/Net45/Net60? Early-pay options (1.5% net15) are available if you prefer.

I attached the Redwood-AP-Onboarding-Packet.pdf. Once you return the filled form we can provision a vendor record and produce the sample invoice within 2 business days. If that looks good we can schedule a 30-minute handoff call this week.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Hi Marta / Julien — thanks for the patience. Looping in Laura from Finance to confirm final remit details.

We can support both options (line-level entity tags or split invoices). Practically, the quickest and least disruptive for AP systems is to issue two invoices that reference the same master PO but append an entity suffix in the invoice metadata: e.g., PO: 88711-US and PO: 88711-EU. Each invoice will:

- Use the correct Redwood legal entity name and tax ID for the billed entity (we will print the EU VAT ID on the EU invoice header and include the tax calculation line).
- Include a clear Remit-To section with the correct bank account and currency.
- Reference the master PO in a dedicated field so your procurement systems can reconcile (we will populate a field "Master PO: 88711").
- Support different payment terms per invoice (Net30 / Net45) — our billing engine can emit per-invoice terms.

Attached is a sample-invoice-split.pdf showing the EU VAT line and the PO-suffix convention, plus a Mutual Action Plan spreadsheet (MutualActionPlan-novacorp.xlsx) with the recommended timeline:

Mutual action highlights:
- Day 0: Novacorp submits completed Redwood vendor registration (vendor form)
- Day 1–2: Redwood provision vendor record in Novacorp portal; Redwood sends sample invoices for validation
- Day 3–5: Novacorp tax/ap confirm sample invoice acceptance or request edits
- Day 6: Final test invoice sent (non-payable), Novacorp confirms remit routing/GL mapping
- Day 8: Go-live — invoices issued for actual services

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync tomorrow (Fri) to run through the sample and the portal fields. Please confirm availability and preferred time.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample-invoice-split.pdf (PDF, 34KB); MutualActionPlan-novacorp.xlsx (XLSX, 16KB)
